response.description:
Microsoft announces the opening of its cloud region in
Denmark to accelerate digital transformation and AI innovation. The Denmark
East region provides Danish customers with local, secure cloud infrastructure,
supporting local data residency, low latency, an access to advanced cloud and
AI services.  For customers looking to leverage
the new region and Availability Zones, Azure offers region portability for
multiple resources with Azure
Resource Mover. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Microsoft Azure now available from new cloud region in Denmark
